waveLog.result: done: src/table/layout.ts reworked to prefer gap compression then uniform per-row card-scale shrink (SCALE_STEPS 1/0.85/0.7/0.55/0.45) with row pitch always >= scaled row height so melds NEVER overlap within the reduced TABLE_AREA_H=102 (was overlapping via a y-clamp that collapsed overflow rows onto each other); GameScene.layoutMelds/makeCardSprite/wireDrag now apply per-meld cardScale to sprite size, drag hover/shadow sizing, and meld-pad; 17->21 layout tests incl. no-overlap assertions up to 80-card stress case; invalid-meld reason badge changed from always-on floating label (which spilled onto neighboring melds at crowded tables) to a hover-only tooltip on the ✗ badge, clamped inside the table/HUD area. Button unification: PixelButton (src/ui/widgets.ts) now actually applies its `color` option as a multiply-tint on textured buttons (previously silently ignored for hover/pressed/disabled), added shade()+STATE_SHADE for consistent hover/pressed/disabled shading from one palette color, added DANGER_TINT export and setSelected() gold-ring state; replaced every flat-rectangle secondary button (MenuScene TUTORIAL/REGRAS/ENGLISH, WinScene NOVA PARTIDA/MENU, SetupScene VOLTAR + player-count chips, settings panel Silenciar/reduced-motion/large-text/English/APAGAR DADOS/FECHAR + reset-confirm Yes/No) with the wooden btn-comprar/btn-small textures (danger buttons tinted red via DANGER_TINT); player-count chips get setSelected(true) gold ring instead of alpha-only.
